- 2,151,400,000 ÷ 29,051 ÷ 365 = 202.89 litres per resident per day

Kelmarsh:
- 1,739 megalitres × 1,000,000 = 1,739,000,000 litres
- 1,739,000,000 ÷ 24,117 ÷ 365 = 197.65 litres per resident per day

Difference:
- 202.89 − 197.65 = 5.24 litres per resident per day

Lindenmoor used more water.
